description: Open interest spikes across every Hyperliquid perp: coins whose open interest moved abnormally in the last hour against their own previous day, with the 1h, 4h and 24h change (in coin units, so a price move does not count), a spike z-score, the price move and funding. Read from our own 5-minute sampler: it answers 503 and is never billed until that record is 24 hours deep. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
